> 第十章 导师的褒奖（第1页）
“自由的芳香！”虽然被押解到地牢的时间只有半日，但当塞恩重见魔法学院上空昏黄色的萤石光芒时，还是不禁感叹道。
这处地牢可不是寻常地方，几乎很少有学徒进去后，还能出来。
包括据说一些正式黑魔法师也曾在这里接受过审判，至于是不是真的，就不是塞恩所能知道的了。
离开地牢后，塞恩一瘸一拐的与莉娜相互扶着，朝他们的家走去。
院长达达隆可没有出来送他们，包括那个老巫婆也随后消失不见，只是在离开地牢前，嘴巴微微努动，似乎是吩咐了莉娜些什么事情。
“不仅黑鲛鳞鱼吃不成，看来我们搬家的计划也得往后缓一缓了。”塞恩对莉娜苦笑道。
此时莉娜身上的伤势不比塞恩差多少，面对塞恩的苦笑，莉娜则低头恢复其冰冷模样。
沉默许久，直到快要返回他们的宿舍楼时，莉娜才开口对塞恩说道：“我那位师叔名为费伦娜，她表示要收我为弟子，继承我们这一脉的暗元素魔法。”
“其实在导师去世后，费伦娜师叔就有关注过我，不过直至我晋升高级学徒，她才明确表示愿意收我为弟子。”
“论实力之强和研究暗元素魔法之深入，费伦娜师叔似乎比我导师当年都强。”莉娜解释道。
莉娜的解释，让塞恩提起许久的心，终于放下。
虽然他和莉娜各自都有些秘密和未向对方敞开的空间，但作为同床共枕，又是并肩战斗，经历过生死的人，他还是希望双方都能对彼此坦诚些。
莉娜的解释，让塞恩面庞发出由衷的笑意。
有一位实力强大的正式黑魔法师愿意收莉娜为弟子，这对莉娜显然是件好事。
也是莉娜的解释，让他们俩的关系，与过去相比，又更进一步。
一直以来，塞恩都是比较主动的一方，没想到莉娜有一天，也会向他坦白些事情。
“或许我的姓氏以及童年出身，也能抽个时间跟莉娜说说了。”塞恩心里想到。
从宿舍楼搬家之事，暂时未能成行。

但三天之日已满后，塞恩必须老老实实的赶到摩西多大师的实验室报道。
与三天前塞恩只是腹部受伤，并且有轻微中毒迹象不同。
此时的塞恩，明显身上的伤势更重了。
甚至他敲开摩西多大师的实验室门时，左臂都缠着一圈厚重的绷带。
看着面前伤势更重了几分的塞恩，摩西多大师泛黄色的眼睛不禁皱了皱，问道：“怎么回事？”
再来摩西多大师的实验室，塞恩心里其实并没有多少底。
黑魔法师们普遍残暴、桀骜的性格，让塞恩不止一次担心，摩西多大师看到自己这幅模样后，会不会直接将自己扫地出门。
毕竟黑魔法学院不养闲人，以塞恩此时的状态，显然帮不了摩西多大师什么魔法实验。
不过塞恩终究还是硬着头皮来了，摩西多大师才是他接下来立足黑魔法学院的最大靠山。
女友莉娜那边，莉娜所依附的也不过是她新认的导师费伦娜罢了。

> Chapter 10 Mentor’s Praise (Page 1)
"The fragrance of freedom!" Although he was escorted to the dungeon for only half a day, Thain couldn't help but sigh when he saw the dim yellow fluorite light over the Magic Academy again.
This dungeon is an unusual place, and few apprentices can come out after entering it.
Including it is said that some official black magicians have been tried here. As to whether it is true or not, Thain cannot know.
After leaving the dungeon, Thain limped and Lina supported each other and walked towards their home.
Dean Dadalon did not come out to see them off, and the old witch also disappeared. Before leaving the dungeon, her mouth moved slightly, as if she had given Lina something.
"Not only can we not eat the black shark scale fish, but it seems that our moving plan will also have to be postponed." Thain smiled bitterly at Lina.
At this time, Lina's injuries were not much worse than Thain's. Facing Thain's wry smile, Lina lowered her head and returned to her cold appearance.
There was silence for a long time, and it was not until they were about to return to their dormitory that Lina spoke to Thain and said, "My uncle's name is Ferena. She said she would accept me as a disciple and inherit the dark element magic of our lineage."
"Actually, after the death of my mentor, Uncle Ferena had paid attention to me, but it wasn't until I was promoted to a senior apprentice that she made it clear that she was willing to accept me as a disciple."
"In terms of strength and in-depth research on dark element magic, Uncle Ferena seems to be stronger than my mentor back then." Lina explained.
Lina's explanation made Thain worry about it for a long time and finally let it go.
Although he and Lina each have some secrets and spaces that are not open to each other, as people who share a bed, fight side by side, and have experienced life and death, he still hopes that both parties can be honest with each other.
Lina's explanation brought a heartfelt smile to Thane's face.
There is a powerful official black magician who is willing to accept Lina as a disciple, which is obviously a good thing for Lina.
It was also Lina's explanation that made their relationship go further than before.
Thain has always been the more proactive person, but he didn't expect that Lina would confess something to him one day.
"Maybe I can take some time to talk to Lina about my surname and childhood background." Thain thought to himself.
Moving from the dormitory building is currently not possible.
But after the three days were up, Thain had to rush to Master Mosido's laboratory to report.
Unlike three days ago, Thain only suffered an abdominal injury and showed slight signs of poisoning.
At this time, Thain's injuries were obviously more serious.
Even when he knocked on the door of Master Moshedo's laboratory, his left arm was wrapped in a thick bandage.
Looking at Thane, who was a little more seriously injured in front of him, Master Mosheduo couldn't help but wrinkled his yellow eyes and asked, "What's going on?"
Returning to Master Mosido's laboratory, Thain actually didn't have much confidence in his heart.
The generally cruel and unruly character of black magicians made Thane worry more than once whether Master Mosido would kick him out directly after seeing what he looked like.
After all, the Black Magic Academy doesn't support idle people. In Thain's current state, it's obvious that he can't help Master Moses with any magic experiments.
However, Thain finally came here, and Master Mosheduo was his biggest backer to establish a foothold in the Black Magic Academy.
As for her girlfriend Lina, Lina only relies on her new mentor Ferena.
